text:
danielle: FYI — Customer ClearMed (tenant t-clearmed) reports org admins suddenly can't see model list or billing tab after yesterday's role refactor. Getting `403: insufficient_permissions` when trying to launch models. Ticket CS-4821.

mike: Can you paste the tenant id and a quick repro? Also, any recent RBAC releases?

danielle: tenant: t-clearmed. repro: console -> Models -> 403. CLI `rw models list --tenant t-clearmed` returns empty list for org-admin users. Non-admin users unaffected. We rolled a roles mapping PR last night (release 2024-04-06 02:45 UTC) that flattened service roles.

ashwin: pinging eng-sre. Possible rolesync or attribute mapping lag. I'll check the role-translation logs and propagation metrics.

rbac-sync-bot: job=rolesync/2024-04-06-03:00 status=STARTED shards=4

ashwin: seeing elevated tail latencies on role-propagation queue and one shard reporting `cache write timeout`. That shard hosts attribute-index for region-us-east-1.

irene: also noticed KMS envelope rotations for the tenant at 02:48 UTC — KMS returned transient 5xx on unwrap twice. Could that block role attachments?

mike: If the role attachment path needs decrypting metadata and KMS failed, the propagator may have skipped write and left users in limbo. Check audit logs for attach events.

ashwin: grabbing audit logs: `audit.search --tenant t-clearmed --event role.attach --since 2024-04-06T02:40Z` returns sparse hits. Last successful attach before release: 2024-04-06T02:43Z, then failures at 02:48: unwrap error, propagator skipped.

cse-liz: customer is impacted across 3 org-admins, escalation high. They need temporary admin access restoration ASAP.

ashwin: quick mitigation: forcing a full role re-propagation and targeting shard that errored. Command I ran:

```
rbacctl sync --tenant t-clearmed --shard us-east-1-2 --force --retry-kms
```

ashwin: Also bumped propagator retry for KMS unwrap to 5 and cleared local shard cache. Monitor shows re-attach events starting 03:12 UTC.

rbac-sync-bot: job=rolesync/2024-04-06-03:12 status=COMPLETED reattached=18 errors=0 duration=22s

danielle: customer confirmed via phone that org-admins can now see models and billing. They reported some stale caches in UI; instructing them to hard refresh.

mike: Root cause summary for postmortem: role-mapping refactor introduced a short window where attribute writes hit a sharded propagator; one shard had KMS unwrap transient errors due to a backend outage; propagator skipped writes on unwrap failure (no retry), so role attachments were incomplete. Two fixes: 1) add KMS retry/backoff in propagator (merged), 2) make propagator durable on temp decrypt failures (ticket ENG-7822). Also add alerting for attach-skip ratio.

irene: I've added an audit-gap run to compare attach events vs expected for last 24h and scheduled KMS healthplay to vendor.

cse-liz: Customer happy, asked for summary email and ja-runbook steps. Danielle, can you send the recovery steps + timeline to CS and include the customer?

danielle: Will do. Draft: timeline, cause, mitigations (force sync command, KMS retry bump, follow-up PRs ENG-7822/ENG-7823), and confirmation that access restored at 03:14 UTC.

mike: marking resolved in slack but keep postmortem sync for tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
